title: GameStop makes $56 billion takeover bid for eBay
title_zh: GameStop 出价 560 亿美元收购 eBay
summary: US video game retailer GameStop made a takeover bid on Sunday to buy eBay for about $55.5 billion in an attempt to turn the online marketplace into a competitor to e-commerce giant Amazon.“It could be a legit competitor to Amazon."
summary_zh: 美国视频游戏零售商GameStop周日提出收购要约，以约555亿美元收购eBay，试图将在线市场转变为电子商务巨头亚马逊的竞争对手。“它可能成为亚马逊的合法竞争对手。”

title: GameStop Offers to Buy eBay for $56 Billion
title_zh: GameStop 提出以 560 亿美元收购 eBay
summary: CEO Ryan Cohen said GameStop has built a roughly 5% stake in eBay and was offering $125 a share in cash and stock.
summary_zh: 首席执行官瑞安·科恩 (Ryan Cohen) 表示，GameStop 已持有 eBay 约 5% 的股份，并提供每股 125 美元的现金加股票。

title: This High-Yield Bond ETF Offers Steady Cash Flow and Low Volatility
title_zh: 这款高收益债券 ETF 提供稳定的现金流和低波动性
summary: Income investors face a familiar bind in 2026: investment-grade bonds yield around the 10-year Treasury’s roughly 4.4%, while equities like the S&P 500 have returned roughly 28% over the past year with stomach-churning volatility along the way.
summary_zh: 收入投资者在 2026 年面临着熟悉的困境：10 年期美国国债的投资级债券收益率约为 4.4%，而标准普尔 500 指数等股票在过去一年中的回报率约为 28%，一路上波动剧烈。

title: BASF Coatings Launches $2 Billion Debt Sale To Fund Carlyle Acquisition
title_zh: 巴斯夫涂料公司启动 20 亿美元债务出售，为凯雷收购提供资金
summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus. Banks have moved to launch a debt sale exceeding $2 billion tied to the carve-out of BASF SE's (BASFY) coatings division, a deal that could offer a timely read on investor appetite for chemicals exposure.
summary_zh: 本文首发于 GuruFocus。银行已着手启动一项超过 20 亿美元的债务出售，与剥离巴斯夫股份公司 (BASFY) 涂料部门相关，这项交易可以及时了解投资者对化学品敞口的兴趣。
